why: This is the defect the first draft shipped, restored exactly: it called `resolveOwnerColor`, which is the IDENTITY RING's colour, and an enemy's undefined `controlledBy` resolves to slot 0 -- so every destroyed enemy left a wreck in player one's 0x3fd0ff. Issue #232 asks the wreck to carry the dead tank's identity, and a single colour for every death discards it while still producing a wreck of the right shape, in the right place, on the right clock. It was invisible to a green test suite and was only found by photographing the built page.
killedBy: the wreck carries the dead tank's identity wears the HULL's colour darkened, not the owner ring's
